system_description.narrative_title: China's export controls and export-driven growth amid domestic strain
system_description.narrative_summary: The dominant narrative ties Beijing's move to tighten export controls on advanced technologies (AI, chips, solar and industrial equipment) to intensifying US-China rivalry while exports simultaneously drive a surprise Q3 GDP pickup. This is an open system of flows — goods, technologies, capital, regulatory policy and geopolitical pressure — where external demand and strategic competition interact with internal weaknesses (housing slump, debt stress, demographic aging). The result is a feedback loop: export dependence and protectionism relieve short-term growth pressures but amplify long-term structural risks.
system_description.scope: Chinese export policies and controls; cross-border flows of advanced technologies and manufactured goods; domestic macro indicators (GDP, exports, housing, debt, demographics); Chinese industrial actors and policymakers; international market responses.
system_description.super_system: Global trade-technology-geopolitics system (US-China strategic competition, global supply chains, multilateral trade and investment regimes).
adjacent_subsystems: Domestic financial system and property market
Global semiconductor and AI technology supply chains
European and other export markets (trade partners)
Demographics and labor markets (aging, youth employment)

variables.name: Export volume
variables.description: The aggregate physical and value quantity of goods and technologies shipped abroad per unit time.

variables.name: Share of advanced technologies in exports
variables.description: The proportion of exported goods and services composed of advanced technologies (e.g., semiconductors, AI-related hardware, high-end manufacturing equipment).

variables.name: Export control stringency
variables.description: The overall restrictiveness of regulatory measures that limit outbound transfers of goods, technologies, and related know-how.

variables.name: External demand for exports
variables.description: The level of foreign final and intermediate demand for domestically produced goods and technologies.

variables.name: Domestic consumption level
variables.description: The aggregate real household and government consumption of goods and services within the economy.

variables.name: Housing price growth rate
variables.description: The tempo of change in residential real estate prices measured as a percentage growth rate over time.

variables.name: Corporate debt burden
variables.description: The outstanding stock of corporate liabilities relative to earnings and assets, indicating leverage pressure on firms.

variables.name: Demographic aging rate
variables.description: The pace at which the population's age structure shifts toward older age cohorts, measured as change in dependency metrics.

variables.name: Labor force size
variables.description: The total number of persons available and willing to work, measured as an active labor-stock level.

variables.name: Productivity growth rate
variables.description: The rate of change in output per unit of labor or capital, reflecting technological and efficiency improvements over time.

variables.name: Net foreign capital flows
variables.description: The net inflow or outflow of cross-border financial capital including investment, loans, and portfolio movements per unit time.

variables.name: Exchange rate trend
variables.description: The direction and rate of change of the domestic currency's value against major foreign currencies over time.

variables.name: Technology diffusion rate
variables.description: The speed at which new technologies and know-how spread across firms, sectors, and borders.

variables.name: Supply chain integration
variables.description: The degree of connectivity and mutual dependence among domestic and international production and distribution networks.

variables.name: Trade barrier intensity
variables.description: The aggregate strength of tariffs, quotas, export/import restrictions and non-tariff measures affecting cross-border trade.

variables.name: Financial system resilience
variables.description: The capacity of financial markets, intermediation institutions, and infrastructure to absorb shocks without systemic disruption.

catalysts.title: Rollout of AI/chip export controls
catalysts.description: Draft rules on AI technologies and chips move from proposal to formal regulation, tightening outbound technology transfers.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Beijing seeks tighter grip on AI exports'; 'China Proposes Export Controls on AI Technologies'; 'China unveils draft export controls on AI technologies and chips.'

catalysts.title: Proposed export controls on solar manufacturing tech
catalysts.description: Proposals to restrict outbound solar-manufacturing technologies progress toward implementation, constraining related exports and supply links.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'China proposes export controls on solar-manufacturing technologies'; complements solar export coverage.

catalysts.title: Enforcement of tunnel-boring-machine export controls
catalysts.description: Commerce ministry announcement triggers near-term enforcement steps and compliance requirements for TBM exports.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'China commerce ministry announces export controls for tunnel boring machines.'

catalysts.title: Memory-chip squeeze and export-driven revenue spike
catalysts.description: Tight memory markets lift revenues and shipments for domestic memory makers, altering export composition and supply ties.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'China’s CXMT Expects Over Eightfold Revenue Jump Amid Memory Squeeze' indicates near-term export/production shifts.

catalysts.title: Persistence of export-led GDP growth
catalysts.description: The current export surge continues to drive GDP growth into the near term, sustaining high external shipments despite weak domestic demand.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China’s economy picks up pace at 4.5% growth'; 'exports surge'; 'Exports power ahead.'

catalysts.title: Continuation of solar-panel export slump
catalysts.description: Solar-panel shipments and related export receipts remain weak in coming months, depressing sectoral export performance.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'China's solar panel exports extend slump in September' and solar-tech controls coverage.

catalysts.title: Debt-driven corporate stress and fiscal pressure
catalysts.description: State-driven ambitions and weakening growth deepen corporate leverage and strain financial buffers, risking systemic stress.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Xi’s Superpower Ambitions Fuel a Dangerous Debt Spiral in China'; 'Weakening economy' coverage.

catalysts.title: Further declines in new-home prices
catalysts.description: New-home prices keep falling, pressuring developers' balance sheets and dampening household wealth and consumption.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China's new home prices fall again' and 'recovery remains elusive.'

catalysts.title: Gradual appreciation of the yuan
catalysts.description: Expectations and policy keep the yuan's gains gradual, modestly affecting export competitiveness and cross‑border flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Pace of Chinese Yuan’s Gains Vs Dollar Likely to Remain Gradual.'

catalysts.title: Beijing's projected move to 'super-aged' status
catalysts.description: Demographic projection to super-aged status signals accelerating aging trends that will reshape labor, consumption, and long-term growth.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Beijing's population expected to become super-aged by 2035.'
